title: Compound verbs
summary: Give a verb a second verb that adds a shade of meaning: `-(y)Iver` for something done quickly, casually or out of the blue (*Kapıyı açıver*), `-(y)Akal` for being frozen on the spot (*bakakaldım*), `-(y)Adur` for carrying on (*Siz yiyedurun*), `-(y)Ayaz` and `-(y)Agel` for near misses and long-standing customs, and `-(y)Ip durmak` for things that keep happening.
canDo: Ask for small favours and describe quick, sudden actions with -(y)Iver
Describe surprise and near misses: bakakaldım, düşeyazdım, uyuyakaldım
Tell people to go ahead without you, and say what keeps happening
